purpose: Large hole-punched paper sheet (CSS mask with --hole-period computed by a ResizeObserver) that contains the hero, demo, ops steps and manifesto.
retrievalIneligibleReason: Layout-only container: the hole-punched paper sheet that frames the homepage sections; its content is the other sections, not its own copy.

variants.description: Panel-variant sheet with 1px stone-800 border (0.8px outline below md).

contentBudgetNote: x-maxWords = ceil(1.25 x observed max words in the real copy), rounded up to an even number (min 2); x-observedMaxWords is the measured maximum. x-maxChars (legal) = observed maximum characters. Enforced per instance by schema/semantic_validate.py.

motion.reducedMotionEvidence: Generation requirement: reducedMotionFallback is const-locked per section. Where the clone source shows a real prefers-reduced-motion branch it is cited in measuredFrom; otherwise it is a required fallback, not a measured behaviour.

notes: Container for the four main-sheet sections; no content fields of its own.

rules.layout: Padding 48/17/32; outline drawn with background lines.
